The '''wife''' of [[Jak Bremen]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] was on a hunting trip. Her husband tracked the killers to a hidden [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] established by the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] in order to complete a mission. Together, she and Bremen had a [[Jak Bremen's daughter|daughter]].<ref name="TLCSB" />
